1. The instant petition has been filed by the petitioner averring therein that he is owner of land measuring 08 kanals and 03 marlas falling under Khasra Nos. 630, 631, 632, 633, 634, 635, 636,
637, 638 and 639 situated at Village Chan Dityal, Tehsil Hiranagar, District Kathua.
It is contended that the respondents have started acquisition proceedings for constructing 06 lanes Highway and the land of the petitioner has come under such acquisitions proceedings.
The compensation has been fixed and the same was published in the local newspaper as well as in the award statement.
It is also stated that the portion of land on which the petitioner is claiming absolute ownership and possession is 02 kanals and 14 marlas only.

2. The grievance of petitioners is that though his land has been acquired and the possession has been taken over by the respondents but the respondents are not contemplating to release the compensation in favour of the petitioner.

3. Today, when the matter was taken up, learned counsel appearing for petitioner stated at the Bar that the petitioner would feel satisfied if this petition is, disposed of, by directing respondents to consider the claim of the petitioner for release of compensation in lieu of petitioner's land acquired under the Land Acquisition Act as reflected at page No.2 S. No. 34 of the Award Statement.
